parameters.query:
SELECT 
  c.customer_name,
  c.customer_email,
  o.product_type,
  o.completed_at
FROM woodys_orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_email = c.email
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.completed_at >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  AND c.email NOT IN (
    SELECT customer_email 
    FROM woodys_orders 
    WHERE order_date > DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 90 DAY)
    AND status IN ('pending', 'in_production')
  )
LIMIT 50

SELECT 
  campaign_goal,
  COUNT(*) as campaign_count,
  SUM(emails_sent) as total_sent,
  SUM(emails_opened) as total_opened,
  SUM(clicks) as total_clicks,
  AVG(open_rate) as avg_open_rate,
  AVG(click_rate) as avg_click_rate
FROM marketing_campaigns
WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 90 DAY)
GROUP BY campaign_goal
